newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 11.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Friday:
* Two Afghan military opponents to the new Muslim government of the Taleban have formed an alliance to set up a non-fundamentalist government in the territory that they control.
* Palestinian leader Yassir Arafat said negotiations to get Israel to withdraw from Hebron on the West Bank have gone nowhere and hinted at the risk of further violence in the region.
* Insurance and financial company Aetna Inc said it will reduce its work force by 4,400 jobs or 13 percent.
* Circus rings set up in Moscow's Red Square for the city festival has received severe criticism for being everything from sacrilegious to an insult to national pride.
